title: Command Kernel — psk syscall layer + composition primitive + Obsidian-as-OS + feedback loop
brief: Synthesis-layer capstone on the BACKEND-DEVTOOLS-RGS6 master roadmap. PRISM slash commands hardcode counts/paths/tool-lists, none compose formally, and the awareness layer to fix it is partially built but uncomposed. COMMAND-KERNEL-MS0 builds: (1) a psk CLI + thin MCP syscall layer every command resolves live state through; (2) a formal pipeline-composition primitive that activates the dormant pipeline_integrations: frontmatter; (3) the Obsidian wiki promoted to the literal OS state store at knowledge/wiki/os/; (4) a closed command-telemetry -> adaptive-thresholds feedback loop; plus migration of the existing command corpus to standardized de-hardcoded frontmatter and a set of new composite pipeline commands (count = sum of phases[].units[].creates_command:true; currently 11 across P1+P3). Line-successor to the shipped OBSIDIAN-PRISM-OS-MS0. Reuses/extends pending substrate units across 7 sibling RGS6 milestones rather than rebuilding them. All literal counts in this envelope reference inventory_snapshot (taken at created_at) — runtime consumers MUST refresh via PRISM-INVENTORY-LATEST.md / BUILD_STATE before relying on any number.

inventory_snapshot.doctrine: These numbers MAY have drifted by the time a unit is executed. Each unit's exit_conditions reference these as approximate; runtime consumers must read PRISM-INVENTORY-LATEST.md for the live count.

dependency_graph: depends_on (shipped foundations): HOOK-SYNERGY-MS0, OBSIDIAN-PRISM-OS-MS0, DEV-VELOCITY-AUTOTRIGGER-MS0, ACP-MS0. Soft per-unit substrate deps (pending sibling milestones, NOT hard blockers — each unit's rationale documents the EXTEND-if-shipped / REUSE-if-extant fallback): SKILLS-UTILIZATION-MS0 (U-SKU01/03/04/05/06), KNOWLEDGE-VAULT-MS0 (U-VAULT01/02/03/04), OBSIDIAN-COMPOUND-MS1 (U-OB-1/U-OB-2), GRAPH-AS-LLM-CONTEXT-MS0 (U-GAC01), WIKI-EVOLVE-MS0 (U-WIKI-RENAME-PROPAGATE/U-WIKI-FLEETING-PROMOTE/U-TODOWRITE-HANDOFF-BRIDGE), AUTO-LEARNING-LOOP-MS0 (U-ALL01..06 — U-ALL01 shipped 2026-05-13), HOOKS-AUTOMATION-V2-MS0 (U-HKA05/U-HKA08), ACP-MS0A (automation-chain schema). Phases strictly ordered P0->P1->P2->P3->P4; P4 may overlap P3.
